title: First-Run Onboarding Experience
goal: Guide a new operator through initial setup in 3 steps so they can run their first scan within 5 minutes of installation — without reading documentation.
scope: Implement a first-run onboarding flow that appears when: no engagements exist AND onboarding_completed flag is not set in instance_settings. The flow is a modal overlay with 3 steps: STEP 1 — WELCOME: Product name, one-sentence mission statement, 'Start setup' button. STEP 2 — QUICK SETUP (3 items, each optional/skippable): (a) Connect AI provider — ChatGPT OAuth button or 'Skip for now'; (b) Set default network scope — LAN CIDR input with common presets (10.0.0.0/8, 192.168.0.0/16, 172.16.0.0/12) and 'Skip'; (c) Actor name input (defaults to hostname). STEP 3 — READY: Summary of what was configured, a 'Run your first scan →' button that opens the wizard with the configured defaults pre-filled, and a 'Explore first' button that dismisses to the Dashboard. The onboarding modal can be re-triggered from Settings > Instance > 'Re-run onboarding'. A setup completion checklist widget appears on the Dashboard until all items are completed: [ ] Connect AI provider [ ] Set default scope [ ] Run first scan [ ] Review first finding.
generation_reason: First-time operator experience is currently a blank wizard with no guidance. Every serious product has an onboarding flow. NodeZero, Aikido, and Cobalt all have guided setup. Without it, new operators are dropped into a complex interface with no clear starting point.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement this task until it is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Onboarding modal and setup checklist only. No new backend endpoints beyond instance_settings. All steps are optional/skippable. Does not appear if any engagement exists.

success_criteria: Onboarding modal appears on first launch with no engagements.
All 3 steps complete in under 2 minutes.
Setup checklist widget on Dashboard shows completion status.
must_not_touch: pack registry, validation, approval, deployment, or runtime binding flows

before_promotion: UI quality overhaul (backlog-85) is completed and logged.
after_completion: Update CURRENT_STATE.md with first-run onboarding as active capability.
Promote exactly one next approved task package into NEXT_TASK.md, or set an explicit holding state if the queue is exhausted.

out_of_scope: Multi-step product tour overlay on existing screens
